shared_elements: boat/ship depicted in profile with upturned prow and stern
human or animal figures shown in profile
row of repeated short vertical strokes (crew/oar strokes or crew marks) along a hull
scene organized into a horizontal register
justification: Both surfaces depict a profile ship with sweeping upcurved prow/stern occupying a horizontal band, with repeated small vertical strokes along the hull standing for crew, plus a small quadruped and figures above the vessel. However A's upper field is dominated by large, relatively detailed figures with a horse-like animal, drapery and a mast-like structure treated almost as a narrative tableau, while B is purely linear and schematic with isolated abstracted strokes and a tiny stick-like animal, no defined human bodies, so the correspondence stays at the generic level of 'ship with crew strokes'.
